name: build_secure_quiz_module_foundations
query: ALTER TABLE public.quizzes ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS subject_offering_id uuid REFERENCES public.course_subject_offerings(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS chapter_id uuid REFERENCES public.chapters(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS lesson_id uuid REFERENCES public.lessons(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS description text, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS difficulty text, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS duration_minutes integer, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS display_order integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS is_published boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS is_active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS is_test_data boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(); ALTER TABLE public.quiz_questions ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS question_type text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'single_choice', ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS display_order integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS points integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS difficulty text, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS is_active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(); ALTER TABLE public.quiz_answers ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS display_order integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(); ALTER TABLE public.quiz_attempts ALTER COLUMN completed_at DROP NOT NULL; ALTER TABLE public.quiz_attempts ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'in_progress', ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS started_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS submitted_at timestamptz, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS duration_minutes integer, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS duration_seconds integer, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS percentage numeric(5,2), ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS correct_answers integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS incorrect_answers integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS answers jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS question_snapshot jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS correction_snapshot jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS result_snapshot jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS review_required boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(); DO $$ BEGIN IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname='quizzes_difficulty_check') THEN ALTER TABLE public.quizzes ADD CONSTRAINT quizzes_difficulty_check CHECK (difficulty IS NULL OR difficulty IN ('easy','medium','hard')); END IF; IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname='quizzes_duration_minutes_check') THEN ALTER TABLE public.quizzes ADD CONSTRAINT quizzes_duration_minutes_check CHECK (duration_minutes IS NULL OR duration_minutes > 0); END IF; IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname='quiz_questions_type_check') THEN ALTER TABLE public.quiz_questions ADD CONSTRAINT quiz_questions_type_check CHECK (question_type IN ('single_choice','multiple_choice','true_false','short_answer')); END IF; IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname='quiz_questions_points_check') THEN ALTER TABLE public.quiz_questions ADD CONSTRAINT quiz_questions_points_check CHECK (points > 0); END IF; IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname='quiz_attempts_status_check') THEN ALTER TABLE public.quiz_attempts ADD CONSTRAINT quiz_attempts_status_check CHECK (status IN ('in_progress','submitted','review_required','expired')); END IF; END $$; CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS quizzes_catalog_lookup_idx ON public.quizzes(level_id,series_id,subject_id,is_published,is_active,display_order); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS quizzes_lesson_lookup_idx ON public.quizzes(lesson_id,is_published,is_active,display_order); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS quiz_questions_order_idx ON public.quiz_questions(quiz_id,display_order); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS quiz_answers_order_idx ON public.quiz_answers(question_id,display_order); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS quiz_attempts_history_idx ON public.quiz_attempts(user_id,quiz_id,submitted_at DESC); CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.set_quiz_record_updated_at() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path=public AS $$ BEGIN NEW.updated_at=now(); RETURN NEW; END; $$; DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS set_quizzes_updated_at ON public.quizzes; CREATE TRIGGER set_quizzes_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.quizzes FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.set_quiz_record_updated_at(); DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS set_quiz_questions_updated_at ON public.quiz_questions; CREATE TRIGGER set_quiz_questions_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.quiz_questions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.set_quiz_record_updated_at(); DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS set_quiz_answers_updated_at ON public.quiz_answers; CREATE TRIGGER set_quiz_answers_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.quiz_answers FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.set_quiz_record_updated_at(); DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS set_quiz_attempts_updated_at ON public.quiz_attempts; CREATE TRIGGER set_quiz_attempts_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.quiz_attempts FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.set_quiz_record_updated_at(); ALTER TABLE public.quizzes ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; ALTER TABLE public.quiz_questions ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; ALTER TABLE public.quiz_answers ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; ALTER TABLE public.quiz_attempts ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; DROP POLICY IF EXISTS select_quizzes_authenticated ON public.quizzes; DROP POLICY IF EXISTS admin_delete_quizzes ON public.quizzes; DROP POLICY IF EXISTS admin_insert_quizzes ON public.quizzes; DROP POLICY IF EXISTS admin_update_quizzes ON public.quizzes; DROP POLICY IF EXISTS select_quiz_questions_authenticated ON public.quiz_questions; DROP POLICY IF EXISTS admin_delete_quiz_questions ON public.quiz_questions; DROP POLICY IF EXISTS admin_insert_quiz_questions ON public.quiz_questions; DROP POLICY IF EXISTS admin_update_quiz_questions ON public.quiz_questions; DROP POLICY IF EXISTS select_quiz_answers_authenticated ON public.quiz_answers; DROP POLICY IF EXISTS admin_delete_quiz_answers ON public.quiz_answers; DROP POLICY IF EXISTS admin_insert_quiz_answers ON public.quiz_answers; DROP POLICY IF EXISTS admin_update_quiz_answers ON public.quiz_answers; DROP POLICY IF EXISTS select_own_or_admin_quiz_attempts ON public.quiz_attempts; DROP POLICY IF EXISTS insert_own_quiz_attempts ON public.quiz_attempts; CREATE POLICY admin_select_quizzes ON public.quizzes FOR SELECT USING (public.is_admin()); CREATE POLICY admin_manage_quizzes ON public.quizzes FOR ALL USING (public.is_admin()) WITH CHECK (public.is_admin()); CREATE POLICY admin_select_quiz_questions ON public.quiz_questions FOR SELECT USING (public.is_admin()); CREATE POLICY admin_manage_quiz_questions ON public.quiz_questions FOR ALL USING (public.is_admin()) WITH CHECK (public.is_admin()); CREATE POLICY admin_select_quiz_answers ON public.quiz_answers FOR SELECT USING (public.is_admin()); CREATE POLICY admin_manage_quiz_answers ON public.quiz_answers FOR ALL USING (public.is_admin()) WITH CHECK (public.is_admin()); CREATE POLICY admin_select_quiz_attempts ON public.quiz_attempts FOR SELECT USING (public.is_admin()); CREATE POLICY admin_manage_quiz_attempts ON public.quiz_attempts FOR ALL USING (public.is_admin()) WITH CHECK (public.is_admin()); CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.can_access_quiz_for_current_student(p_quiz_id uuid) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=public AS $$ SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.quizzes AS q JOIN public.course_subject_offerings AS o ON o.id=q.subject_offering_id JOIN public.subjects AS s ON s.id=q.subject_id JOIN public.profiles AS p ON p.id=auth.uid() JOIN public.levels AS l ON l.id=q.level_id JOIN public.series AS r ON r.id=q.series_id WHERE q.id=p_quiz_id AND q.is_published AND q.is_active AND s.is_active AND o.is_published AND p.school_level=l.name AND p.series=r.name AND o.level_id=q.level_id AND o.series_id=q.series_id AND o.subject_id=q.subject_id); $$; CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_my_quiz_catalog(p_subject_id uuid DEFAULT NULL,p_chapter_id uuid DEFAULT NULL,p_lesson_id uuid DEFAULT NULL,p_difficulty text DEFAULT NULL) RETURNS TABLE(quiz_id uuid,title text,description text,subject_id uuid,subject_name text,chapter_id uuid,chapter_title text,lesson_id uuid,lesson_title text,difficulty text,duration_minutes integer,question_count integer,display_order integer,attempt_count integer,last_status text,last_percentage numeric,best_percentage numeric) LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=public AS $$ SELECT q.id,q.title,q.description,q.subject_id,s.name,q.chapter_id,c.title,q.lesson_id,l.title,q.difficulty,q.duration_minutes,COALESCE(question_counts.count,0)::integer,q.display_order,COALESCE(attempt_stats.attempt_count,0)::integer,attempt_stats.last_status,attempt_stats.last_percentage,attempt_stats.best_percentage FROM public.quizzes AS q JOIN public.subjects AS s ON s.id=q.subject_id JOIN public.chapters AS c ON c.id=q.chapter_id JOIN public.lessons AS l ON l.id=q.lesson_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT count(*) AS count FROM public.quiz_questions AS qq WHERE qq.quiz_id=q.id AND qq.is_active) AS question_counts ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT count(*) AS attempt_count,(array_agg(a.status ORDER BY a.started_at DESC))[1] AS last_status,(array_agg(a.percentage ORDER BY a.started_at DESC))[1] AS last_percentage,max(a.percentage) FILTER (WHERE a.status IN ('submitted','expired')) AS best_percentage FROM public.quiz_attempts AS a WHERE a.quiz_id=q.id AND a.user_id=auth.uid()) AS attempt_stats ON true WHERE public.can_access_quiz_for_current_student(q.id) AND (p_subject_id IS NULL OR q.subject_id=p_subject_id) AND (p_chapter_id IS NULL OR q.chapter_id=p_chapter_id) AND (p_lesson_id IS NULL OR q.lesson_id=p_lesson_id) AND (p_difficulty IS NULL OR q.difficulty=p_difficulty) ORDER BY q.display_order,q.created_at; $$; CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_my_quiz_detail(p_quiz_id uuid) RETURNS TABLE(quiz_id uuid,title text,description text,subject_name text,chapter_title text,lesson_title text,difficulty text,duration_minutes integer,questions jsonb) LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=public AS $$ SELECT q.id,q.title,q.description,s.name,c.title,l.title,q.difficulty,q.duration_minutes,COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',qq.id,'prompt_markdown',qq.question,'question_type',qq.question_type,'points',qq.points,'options',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',qa.id,'answer',qa.answer) ORDER BY qa.display_order,qa.id) FROM public.quiz_answers AS qa WHERE qa.question_id=qq.id),'[]'::jsonb)) ORDER BY qq.display_order,qq.created_at) FROM public.quiz_questions AS qq WHERE qq.quiz_id=q.id AND qq.is_active),'[]'::jsonb) FROM public.quizzes AS q JOIN public.subjects AS s ON s.id=q.subject_id JOIN public.chapters AS c ON c.id=q.chapter_id JOIN public.lessons AS l ON l.id=q.lesson_id WHERE q.id=p_quiz_id AND public.can_access_quiz_for_current_student(q.id); $$; CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.start_quiz_attempt(p_quiz_id uuid) RETURNS TABLE(attempt_id uuid,quiz_id uuid,status text,started_at timestamptz,duration_minutes integer) LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=public AS $$ DECLARE v_questions jsonb; v_corrections jsonb; v_duration integer; BEGIN IF auth.uid() IS NULL OR NOT public.can_access_quiz_for_current_student(p_quiz_id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Ce quiz n’est pas disponible pour votre profil scolaire.'; END IF; SELECT q.duration_minutes,COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',qq.id,'prompt_markdown',qq.question,'question_type',qq.question_type,'points',qq.points,'options',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',qa.id,'answer',qa.answer) ORDER BY qa.display_order,qa.id) FROM public.quiz_answers AS qa WHERE qa.question_id=qq.id),'[]'::jsonb)) ORDER BY qq.display_order,qq.created_at) FROM public.quiz_questions AS qq WHERE qq.quiz_id=q.id AND qq.is_active),'[]'::jsonb),COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',qq.id,'question_type',qq.question_type,'correct_option_ids',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(qa.id ORDER BY qa.display_order,qa.id) FROM public.quiz_answers AS qa WHERE qa.question_id=qq.id AND qa.is_correct),'[]'::jsonb),'explanation_markdown',qq.explanation) ORDER BY qq.display_order,qq.created_at) FROM public.quiz_questions AS qq WHERE qq.quiz_id=q.id AND qq.is_active),'[]'::jsonb) INTO v_duration,v_questions,v_corrections FROM public.quizzes AS q WHERE q.id=p_quiz_id; IF jsonb_array_length(v_questions)=0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Ce quiz ne comporte pas encore de question active.'; END IF; RETURN QUERY INSERT INTO public.quiz_attempts AS a(user_id,quiz_id,score,total_questions,status,started_at,duration_minutes,question_snapshot,correction_snapshot) VALUES(auth.uid(),p_quiz_id,0,jsonb_array_length(v_questions),'in_progress',now(),v_duration,v_questions,v_corrections) RETURNING a.id,a.quiz_id,a.status,a.started_at,a.duration_minutes; END; $$; CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.submit_quiz_attempt(p_attempt_id uuid,p_answers jsonb) RETURNS TABLE(attempt_id uuid,status text,score integer,percentage numeric,total_questions integer,correct_answers integer,incorrect_answers integer,submitted_at timestamptz,duration_seconds integer,review_required boolean) LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=public AS $$ DECLARE v_attempt public.quiz_attempts%ROWTYPE; v_question jsonb; v_solution jsonb; v_question_id text; v_answer jsonb; v_type text; v_points integer; v_correct boolean; v_total integer:=0; v_auto_points integer:=0; v_earned_points integer:=0; v_correct_count integer:=0; v_incorrect_count integer:=0; v_review boolean:=false; v_feedback jsonb:='[]'::jsonb; v_percentage numeric; v_status text; BEGIN IF jsonb_typeof(p_answers) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Les réponses doivent être fournies sous la forme d’un objet.'; END IF; SELECT a.* INTO v_attempt FROM public.quiz_attempts AS a WHERE a.id=p_attempt_id AND a.user_id=auth.uid() AND a.status='in_progress' FOR UPDATE; IF v_attempt.id IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Cette tentative ne peut pas être soumise.'; END IF; FOR v_question IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_attempt.question_snapshot) LOOP v_question_id:=v_question->>'id'; v_type:=v_question->>'question_type'; v_points:=COALESCE((v_question->>'points')::integer,1); v_answer:=COALESCE(p_answers->v_question_id,'[]'::jsonb); SELECT value INTO v_solution FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_attempt.correction_snapshot) AS sol WHERE sol.value->>'id'=v_question_id LIMIT 1; v_solution:=COALESCE(v_solution,'{}'::jsonb); v_total:=v_total+1; IF v_type IN ('single_choice','true_false','multiple_choice') THEN v_auto_points:=v_auto_points+v_points; IF v_type='multiple_choice' THEN SELECT NOT EXISTS ((SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(v_solution->'correct_option_ids','[]'::jsonb)) EXCEPT SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(v_answer)) UNION ALL (SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(v_answer) EXCEPT SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(v_solution->'correct_option_ids','[]'::jsonb)))) INTO v_correct; ELSE v_correct:=COALESCE(v_solution->'correct_option_ids','[]'::jsonb)=v_answer; END IF; IF v_correct THEN v_earned_points:=v_earned_points+v_points; v_correct_count:=v_correct_count+1; ELSE v_incorrect_count:=v_incorrect_count+1; END IF; ELSE v_review:=true; v_correct:=NULL; END IF; v_feedback:=v_feedback||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('id',v_question_id,'is_correct',v_correct,'correct_option_ids',COALESCE(v_solution->'correct_option_ids','[]'::jsonb),'explanation_markdown',v_solution->>'explanation_markdown')); END LOOP; v_percentage:=CASE WHEN v_auto_points>0 THEN round((v_earned_points::numeric/v_auto_points::numeric)*100,2) ELSE NULL END; v_status:=CASE WHEN v_review THEN 'review_required' ELSE 'submitted' END; UPDATE public.quiz_attempts AS a SET answers=p_answers,result_snapshot=v_feedback,status=v_status,score=v_earned_points,percentage=v_percentage,total_questions=v_total,correct_answers=v_correct_count,incorrect_answers=v_incorrect_count,review_required=v_review,submitted_at=now(),completed_at=now(),duration_seconds=GREATEST(0,EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM(now()-a.started_at))::integer) WHERE a.id=p_attempt_id; RETURN QUERY SELECT a.id,a.status,a.score,a.percentage,a.total_questions,a.correct_answers,a.incorrect_answers,a.submitted_at,a.duration_seconds,a.review_required FROM public.quiz_attempts AS a WHERE a.id=p_attempt_id; END; $$; CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_my_quiz_attempt_result(p_attempt_id uuid) RETURNS TABLE(attempt_id uuid,quiz_id uuid,title text,status text,score integer,percentage numeric,total_questions integer,correct_answers integer,incorrect_answers integer,started_at timestamptz,submitted_at timestamptz,duration_seconds integer,review_required boolean,questions jsonb) LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=public AS $$ SELECT a.id,a.quiz_id,q.title,a.status,a.score,a.percentage,a.total_questions,a.correct_answers,a.incorrect_answers,a.started_at,a.submitted_at,a.duration_seconds,a.review_required,COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',j.value->>'id','prompt_markdown',j.value->>'prompt_markdown','question_type',j.value->>'question_type','options',j.value->'options','answer',a.answers->(j.value->>'id'),'is_correct',fb.value->'is_correct','correct_option_ids',fb.value->'correct_option_ids','explanation_markdown',fb.value->>'explanation_markdown') ORDER BY ordinality) FROM jsonb_array_elements(a.question_snapshot) WITH ORDINALITY AS j(value,ordinality) LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(a.result_snapshot) AS f WHERE f.value->>'id'=j.value->>'id' LIMIT 1) AS fb ON true),'[]'::jsonb) FROM public.quiz_attempts AS a JOIN public.quizzes AS q ON q.id=a.quiz_id WHERE a.id=p_attempt_id AND a.user_id=auth.uid() AND a.status<>'in_progress'; $$; CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_my_quiz_history() RETURNS TABLE(attempt_id uuid,quiz_id uuid,title text,status text,score integer,percentage numeric,started_at timestamptz,submitted_at timestamptz,best_percentage numeric,attempt_count integer) LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=public AS $$ SELECT a.id,a.quiz_id,q.title,a.status,a.score,a.percentage,a.started_at,a.submitted_at,(SELECT max(a2.percentage) FROM public.quiz_attempts AS a2 WHERE a2.user_id=auth.uid() AND a2.quiz_id=a.quiz_id AND a2.status IN ('submitted','expired')),(SELECT count(*)::integer FROM public.quiz_attempts AS a3 WHERE a3.user_id=auth.uid() AND a3.quiz_id=a.quiz_id) FROM public.quiz_attempts AS a JOIN public.quizzes AS q ON q.id=a.quiz_id WHERE a.user_id=auth.uid() AND a.status<>'in_progress' ORDER BY a.submitted_at DESC; $$; CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_admin_quiz_overview() RETURNS TABLE(students_with_attempts integer,submitted_attempts integer,average_percentage numeric,quiz_count integer) LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path=public AS $$ BEGIN IF NOT public.is_admin() THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Accès administrateur requis.'; END IF; RETURN QUERY SELECT (SELECT count(DISTINCT a.user_id)::integer FROM public.quiz_attempts AS a),(SELECT count(*)::integer FROM public.quiz_attempts AS a WHERE a.status IN ('submitted','review_required','expired')),(SELECT round(avg(a.percentage),2) FROM public.quiz_attempts AS a WHERE a.percentage IS NOT NULL),(SELECT count(*)::integer FROM public.quizzes AS q); END; $$; REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.can_access_quiz_for_current_student(uuid) FROM PUBLIC; REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.get_my_quiz_catalog(uuid,uuid,uuid,text) FROM PUBLIC; REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.get_my_quiz_detail(uuid) FROM PUBLIC; REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.start_quiz_attempt(uuid) FROM PUBLIC; REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.submit_quiz_attempt(uuid,jsonb) FROM PUBLIC; REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.get_my_quiz_attempt_result(uuid) FROM PUBLIC; REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.get_my_quiz_history() FROM PUBLIC; REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.get_admin_quiz_overview() FROM PUBLIC; REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.can_access_quiz_for_current_student(uuid) FROM anon; REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.get_my_quiz_catalog(uuid,uuid,uuid,text) FROM anon; REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.get_my_quiz_detail(uuid) FROM anon; REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.start_quiz_attempt(uuid) FROM anon; REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.submit_quiz_attempt(uuid,jsonb) FROM anon; REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.get_my_quiz_attempt_result(uuid) FROM anon; REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.get_my_quiz_history() FROM anon; REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.get_admin_quiz_overview() FROM anon; GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.can_access_quiz_for_current_student(uuid) TO authenticated; GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.get_my_quiz_catalog(uuid,uuid,uuid,text) TO authenticated; GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.get_my_quiz_detail(uuid) TO authenticated; GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.start_quiz_attempt(uuid) TO authenticated; GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.submit_quiz_attempt(uuid,jsonb) TO authenticated; GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.get_my_quiz_attempt_result(uuid) TO authenticated; GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.get_my_quiz_history() TO authenticated; GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.get_admin_quiz_overview() TO authenticated;
